theater: 馬邑城與雁門關之間的代北邊地

battle.name: 隋王仁恭擊突厥之戰
battle.theater: 馬邑城與雁門關之間的代北邊地
battle.brief: 大業十二年（616年），東突厥始畢可汗再度窺犯代北，隋廷命馬邑太守王仁恭率兵出擊，於馬邑城與雁門關之間的邊地與突厥騎兵交鋒。卡面這名希臘重步兵不屬隋軍，它點出的是同一道理：面對成群衝鋒的騎兵，靠的是成陣互遮而非個人勇力。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 交戰一方是隋朝：中央在江都的隋煬帝遙控，河北行省尚書令晉王楊侑、太原留守越王楊侗分守要衝，邊線上由雁門、馬邑、雲中、定襄一線的郡兵與屯田客組成防區；馬邑是雁門的門戶，郡兵與郡吏歸雁門方面節制，太守王仁恭以治所主將的身份統兵。隋軍主力是府兵與各州郡縣的鄉兵，另有北邊蕃漢雜居的部曲與歸附的塞外部眾，配以城防、烽燧與屯田所出的糧秣，後方輜重沿河東河道與井陘道北運。另一方是東突厥：汗庭由始畢可汗（咄吉）主持，屬下分鐵勒、薛延陀、處羅等部，兵以騎兵為主，牧地與營地隨水草移動，作戰時以旗號集兵、以散騎游鬥邊地，戰利與掠獲既充實牧群也補充人力。兩國同時有互市與姻親：始畢可汗娶隋宗女義成公主，邊市仍開；但汗庭每一次南下都在測試隋朝邊軍的空虛。
countriesEn: One side was the Sui dynasty. The court at Jiangdu under Emperor Yang of Sui gave the orders from afar, while the Prince of Jin Yang Yu, Commissioner of the Hebei Circuit, and the Prince of Yue Yang Dong, who held Taiyuan, watched the key points of the line; the frontier itself was manned by the commandery troops and the military-farm households of the chain of Yanmen, Mayi, Yunzhong and Dingxiang. Mayi was the gateway of Yanmen. Its soldiers and clerks answered to the Yanmen side, and the Administrator of Mayi, Wang Rengong, commanded the district in his capacity as the officer on the spot. The Sui field force consisted mainly of fubing levies and the militia of the prefectures and counties, together with local irregulars of mixed Han and foreign birth along the northern border and with surrendered peoples from beyond the frontier, supported by the fortified posts, the beacon towers and the grain of the military farms; the baggage and supply trains moved north by the river route of Hedong and along the Jingxing road. The other side was the Eastern Turks, whose court was held by the Qaghan of Shibi, that is Duoji, with the Iron, the Xueyantuo and the Chuluo divisions under him. Their strength was cavalry; their pastures and camps moved with the water and the grass; in action they mustered by banner and fought along the frontier as loose skirmishing horse, booty and captives feeding both their herds and their ranks. The two states kept a market and a marriage tie at the same time: Shibi had married Yicheng, a daughter of the Sui imperial clan, and the border markets stayed open. Yet each time the Qaghan's riders came south, they were testing how hollow the Sui frontier was.
people: 主將王仁恭，隋馬邑太守，兼領本地軍政，是這場戰爭在隋朝一方的指揮者。史籍關於他的記載極少，只知大業十二年奉命出擊突厥，翌年二月劉武周在馬邑起兵時將他殺死，這條結局反而成了他生平最可靠的一筆。突厥方面是始畢可汗，即咄吉，東突厥大汗，自開皇末年便與隋朝往來不絕，大業十一年（615年）曾率二十萬騎圍困雁門，逼得隋廷大徵各道援軍，也是本戰的對手。往來兩國的訊息中樞是義成公主：她既是隋宗女，也是始畢可汗之妻，兩邊的書信、贖罪與求婚都經她轉遞。隋廷方面的關鍵人物是煬帝楊廣，大業十二年遠居江都，只能靠河北與並州的留守處置邊事；晉王楊侑以河北行省尚書令總督北方，越王楊侗守太原；前一年死守雁門的名將樊子蓋與一批被擲在關外的將士，是隋朝邊防經驗的主要來源。兩年之後，正是這批將領在亂軍中另找出路，李淵於太原起兵，而太原守將的位置後來落到李世民手上。
peopleEn: The Sui commander was Wang Rengong, Administrator of Mayi, who held the local military command as well and was the commander on the Sui side of this war. The histories say very little about him. All that is certain is that in the twelfth year of Daye he was ordered out against the Turks, and that in the second month of the following year, when Liu Wuzhou rose in Mayi, he was killed; that ending is in fact the most reliable trace his name has left. On the Turkic side stood Shibi Qaghan, that is Duoji, the Great Qaghan of the Eastern Turks, who had kept up relations with the Sui since the end of the Kaihuang era and in the eleventh year of Daye, 615, had led two hundred thousand riders to besiege Yanmen, forcing the Sui court to summon relief from every circuit; he was the opponent in this war. The channel of correspondence between the two states was Yicheng, Princess: a daughter of the Sui imperial clan and the wife of Shibi Qaghan, through whom the letters, the offers of atonement and the marriage proposals of the two courts all passed. On the Sui side the decision was Emperor Yang's, who in the twelfth year of Daye lived far away at Jiangdu and could do nothing but leave the northern defence to the commissioners of Hebei and Bingzhou; the Prince of Jin, Yang Yu, oversaw the north as Commissioner of the Hebei Circuit, and the Prince of Yue, Yang Dong, held Taiyuan. The great defender of Yanmen in the year before, the general Fan Zigai, together with the officers stranded outside the passes, was the main reservoir of the Sui's frontier experience. Two years later it was precisely men of this kind who found another way out of the disorder: Li Yuan rose at Taiyuan, and the command of Taiyuan eventually passed to Li Shimin.
kits: 卡面這名希臘重步兵並不在隋朝軍制裡，也沒有出現在代北任何一次交鋒的記載中；它是一件對照件，用來比照隋軍在開闊地上結陣拒騎的同一套道理。真正投入這場戰爭的是隋朝邊軍的典型裝備：步兵著明光鎧、戴兜鍪，兩手持槊與橫刀，配大盾；弩手用蹶張弩與臂弩發矢，與持槊甲士搭配，構成遠射在前、槊盾在後的組合；騎兵之中既有輕騎，也有披重甲的具裝騎兵，使用馬槊與短刀；防線上備橫拒馬、鹿角、塹壕、障車與木柵，另有雲梯、撞車、飛石等攻城器械，以及火藥製的訊號與火攻之具。糧秣靠雲中、朔州一線的屯田與河運，馬匹則仰給各軍與邊市。突厥那邊是另一套：輕騎為主，人穿皮革札甲，備樺皮圓盾與骨角弓，馬上用馬刀、標槍與套索，全軍以旗幟辨部，士卒少帶重物，靠騎乘的續戰力換取機動。兩邊在城下角力，靠的就是把各自裝備的長處用在哪一邊。
kitsEn: The Greek hoplite on the card belongs to no Sui order of battle and appears in no record of any fighting in northern Dai; it is a comparison piece, set there to show the same principle by which the Sui army closed its ranks in the open ground to withstand cavalry. What actually went into this war was the standard equipment of the Sui frontier troops. The infantry wore bright armour and helmets, carried the sao and the sabre in two hands, and were covered by large shields; crossbowmen worked the tension-drawn crossbow and the arm crossbow and paired with the sao-bearing armoured men, so that missile fire came first and the spear and shield followed. Among the cavalry were light horse, and also armoured lancers using the cavalry lance and the short sword. The frontier line was furnished with spiked fences, wooden abatis, ditches, barricade carts and timber stockades, and there were scaling ladders, battering rams, stone-throwers and other siege engines, together with fire-making weapons used for signals and for burning. Grain came from the military farms and the river transport of the Yunzhong and Shuozhou line, and the horses were drawn from the armies of the various regions and from the border market. The Turks carried a different set. Cavalry was their arm, the men wore leather armour scaled in small plates, and they carried birch-bark round shields and bows of horn and bone, while on horseback they used the sabre, the javelin and the lasso; the whole army was told apart by its banners, the men travelled light, and it was the endurance of their mounts that bought them their mobility. The struggle below the walls was settled by which side used the strengths of its own equipment best.
tactics: 隋軍的戰法是典型的守邊反擊：先以沿邊烽燧與戍卒逐級傳警，馬邑城守軍閉城固守，等突厥離開營地，才以步騎出城迎擊。接戰時，步兵把槊端朝前列成密集的橫陣與縱隊，弩手藏在陣後或兩翼，待敵騎逼近至百步之內才齊發矢；騎兵不與突厥正面纏鬥，只在兩翼游弋，待敵隊形被衝亂時才合擊。關鍵不在一次會戰，而在把突厥拖到沒有水草的地方：代北秋冬水枯草黃，馬匹掉膘，突厥必須在雪前退回漠北，故隋軍的任務是守住這一段河谷、截斷其小股掠奪的通道，而不是深入追擊；反過來，隋朝也清楚，追出塞外只會把本就吃緊的糧道拉得更長。糧道同樣是要害：輜重自河東北運，一旦在雁門之外的狹道被遊騎切斷，城中存糧撐不過一冬。因此會戰之後往往還有掃清塞外小部落的追擊，目的是讓對方來年再不敢靠近。
tacticsEn: The Sui way of fighting was a counter-attack from a defended frontier. Beacons and frontier posts passed the alarm stage by stage; the garrison of Mayi shut its gates and held the town, waiting for the Turks to leave their camp, and only then marched out with foot and horse to meet them. In contact, the infantry levelled the points of the sao into a close front, in line and in column, while the crossbowmen lay behind the ranks or on both flanks and loosed their bolts together only when the enemy riders were within a hundred paces. The cavalry did not trade blows with the Turks in the open; they worked the two wings and closed in only after the enemy formation had been thrown into disorder. The point was not any single engagement but to wear the Turks down until they had neither water nor grass. In northern Dai the streams fail and the grass yellows in autumn and winter, the horses lose condition, and the Turks must withdraw north of the desert before the snows; the Sui task was therefore to hold this stretch of river valley and cut the channels by which small bands came to plunder, not to pursue deep into the steppe; put the other way, the Sui were well aware that a chase beyond the frontier would only stretch an already taut supply line. The supply line was the other vital point. Baggage moved north by river, and once it was cut in the narrow defiles beyond Yanmen, the grain stored in the town could not outlast a winter. For that reason a battle was often followed by a sweep of the small Turkic divisions outside the wall, the object being to make the enemy think twice before coming near again in the following year.
data: 可核實的數字不多，記錄本身就稀疏。時間上：《隋書·突厥傳》與《資治通鑑》只把此事繫於大業十二年（616年），確月失載，諸說並存，卡面取的是秋冬之交部署最緊之時的九月。距離上，馬邑在雁門之南數百里，是代北防線的門戶，馬邑以北便是雲中、五原一線的牧地；馬邑到太原也有數百里，後來劉武周正是沿這條線南下，隋廷的援兵與糧車走的也是同一條路。兵力上，史書未載確數，只能確定王仁恭能率一支邊軍出城追擊數十日而不潰，其規模當在數千至萬許之間，但史料不足以指實。作為對照，大業十一年雁門之圍時《通鑑》記突厥二十萬騎，隋廷各道援軍動輒數十萬，兩組數字都帶著史官的誇張，難以細究。斬獲與死傷沒有可以核對的名數，可確認的只有兩點：戰後馬邑仍在隋廷手中；翌年二月劉武周殺王仁恭而據馬邑。
dataEn: Few numbers can be verified, because the record itself is thin. On timing: the History of Sui and the Comprehensive Mirror tie the affair only to the twelfth year of Daye, to 616, the exact month having been lost, and the various accounts do not agree; the card takes the September of the autumn-winter season, when the deployments were tightest. On distance: Mayi lies several hundred li south of Yanmen and is the gateway of the northern Dai line, with the pastures of the Yunzhong and Wuyuan line beyond it to the north; there are also several hundred li from Mayi to Taiyuan, and it was along that same road that Liu Wuzhou later marched south and along it that the Sui's reinforcements and grain wagons travelled. On numbers of troops: the histories give no exact figure, and all that can be certain is that Wang Rengong could lead a frontier force out of the city and keep it in the field for tens of days without breaking, a strength that must have run from several thousand to some ten thousand, though the sources do not permit a firmer statement. As a comparison, during the siege of Yanmen in the eleventh year of Daye the Mirror records two hundred thousand Turkic riders, and the Sui court summoned tens of thousands from every circuit; both sets of figures carry the historian's exaggeration and cannot be examined closely. There is no ledger of kills and losses to check. Only two things can be confirmed: after the fighting Mayi was still in Sui hands, and in the second month of the following year Liu Wuzhou killed Wang Rengong and took the town.
cause: 直接導火線是始畢可汗在隋朝內亂頻仍之際再度南下。大業年間，隋廷三次大舉攻高句麗，役力轉輸遍於天下，河北、山東的亂事接踵而起：616年正月初七，雁門郡人翟松柏在靈丘聚眾數萬，轉攻鄰近各縣；同年趙萬海自恆山寇高陽；地方的郡兵與屯田客一批批脫離版籍，邊軍與剿匪兵互相爭調，馬邑、雁門一線的守備因此被抽空。外來壓力也從大業十一年延續下來：那一年七月始畢可汗率騎圍困雁門，隋煬帝困在關內，雖賴各道援軍與義成公主的傳訊而解圍，卻已把隋朝邊防的虛弱暴露在北方諸部面前。此後突厥步步逼近，掠奪鐵勒等部的牧地、收羅邊民，隋廷不能容忍雁門這個門戶失守，於是命馬邑太守王仁恭率兵出擊，把守邊的任務交給最熟悉代北山川形勢、也最無從推辭的那一位地方官。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was Shibi Qaghan's coming south again while the Sui was being torn apart by civil disorder. During the Daye era the Sui court launched three great campaigns against Goguryeo and the transport of men and supplies was spread across the empire, and rebellions followed one another in Hebei and in Shandong. On the seventh day of the first month of 616, Zhai Songbai, a man of Yanmen prefecture, gathered tens of thousands at Lingqiu and turned on the neighbouring counties; in the same year Zhao Wanhai came down from Hengshan towards Gaoyang. Commandery troops and military-farm households peeled away from the registers one batch after another, frontier troops and bands hunting bandits competed for each other's men, and the garrisons of Mayi and Yanmen were hollowed out in the process. The pressure from outside had been running since the eleventh year of Daye. In the seventh month of that year Shibi Qaghan ringed Yanmen with his horse and Emperor Yang was shut up inside the passes; he was released by the aid of the relief armies of every circuit and of the messages carried by Yicheng, but the weakness of the Sui frontier had by then been laid bare before the peoples of the north. After that the Turks advanced step by step, taking the pastures of such divisions as the Tiele and gathering up the people of the border, and the Sui court could not tolerate the loss of the gateway at Yanmen. It therefore ordered Wang Rengong, Administrator of Mayi, to strike out with his troops, entrusting the defence of the border to the local officer who knew the mountains and rivers of northern Dai best and who had the least room to refuse.
impact: 就當時而言，這一仗的意義不在斬獲，而在它標出了隋朝北方防線的實際位置：隋軍仍能在馬邑一線擋住突厥的一次進攻，卻已經沒有餘力追出塞外，也沒有能力同時壓住河北與並州兩線的亂事。真正改變局面的，是這個結局在一年之內被自己否定——617年二月，劉武周在馬邑殺掉王仁恭，據城北連突厥，隋朝在山西的統治隨之瓦解，太原、晉州相繼陷落，關中被迫應戰，李世民以淺水原、柏壁一役收復失地。邊將死於內亂、外敵乘虛而入，說明以郡兵與屯田守邊的模式已走到盡頭：府兵制在亂局中崩解，散兵落草為盜，北方邊防要等到唐室以均田府兵與自建宿衛重新編製之後才重新成形。制度上的餘波延續到唐初，東突厥在貞觀四年被唐滅掉，而此時邊境上的主角已是唐的天下兵與行軍總管，不再是隋的郡兵。
impactEn: For the moment, the meaning of this engagement lay not in its captures but in what it showed about the real position of the Sui's northern line. The Sui army could still hold the Turks off once at Mayi, yet it had no strength left to pursue them beyond the frontier, and no strength to hold down the rebel fronts of Hebei and Bingzhou at the same time. What truly changed the situation was that this outcome was contradicted by itself within the year. In the second month of 617 Liu Wuzhou killed Wang Rengong at Mayi, seized the town and ranged himself with the Turks; Sui rule in Shanxi fell apart, Taiyuan and Jinzhou were lost in turn, the court at Guanzhong was forced to fight, and Li Shimin recovered the ground at the battles of Qianshuiyuan and Baibi. A frontier officer killed by a domestic revolt while the enemy moved into the vacancy shows that the model of holding the border with commandery troops and military farms had reached its end. The fubing system dissolved amid the disorder, scattered soldiers turned into bandits, and the northern frontier could not be rebuilt until the Tang put the equal-field fubing and its own palace guards back in order. The institutional aftershock ran on into the early Tang: the Eastern Turks were destroyed in the fourth year of Zhenguan, but by then the protagonists on the frontier were the Tang's armies of the realm and its line-commanders, no longer the Sui's commandery levies.
result: 結果屬於不好不壞的那一種。隋軍保住了馬邑，逼退突厥，一度恢復了雁門門戶的秩序，斬獲與殘敵數字失載，戰果無從細究；史載有限，諸說並存，可以確認的只是大業十二年秋冬之交之後，代北邊線上沒有出現突厥的據點，而隋廷也沒有能力把這次反擊變成一場深入漠北的攻勢。守住了城，卻沒有贏回邊境：王仁恭的兵在城內過了一冬，糧秣靠雲中與朔州接濟，而汗庭的騎兵已在別處找到了更容易得手的地方。真正結束這場戰爭的，不是王仁恭的兵，而是一年之後的另一場變故：617年二月，劉武周殺王仁恭於馬邑，與突厥相應，北方秩序全面崩解，隋朝在三年之內覆亡，隋王仁恭的名字則留在《隋書·突厥傳》與《資治通鑑》零星的行文裡，成為大業末年北方邊防空虛的一個註腳。
resultEn: The outcome was of the middling kind. The Sui army saved Mayi, drove the Turks back, and for a while restored the order at the gateway of Yanmen; the number of the slain and of the enemy destroyed is not recorded, and the fruits of the victory cannot be examined. The record is thin and the accounts do not agree. What can be confirmed is that after the autumn of the twelfth year of Daye no Turkic post stood along the northern Dai line, and that the Sui court had no means to turn this counter-stroke into an offensive into the northern desert. The city was held, but the frontier was not won back: Wang Rengong's troops spent the winter inside the walls, their grain coming from Yunzhong and Shuozhou, while the Qaghan's riders had already found easier ground elsewhere. What really ended this war was not Wang Rengong's troops but a different upheaval a year later: in the second month of 617 Liu Wuzhou killed Wang Rengong at Mayi and joined himself with the Turks, the northern order collapsed entirely, the Sui fell within three years, and the name of Wang Rengong survives only in the scattered lines of the History of Sui and the Comprehensive Mirror, as a footnote on the emptiness of the northern frontier at the end of the Daye era.
